items.title: John Fedchock interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 28, 2015
items.q: You know here’s Joe Williams and Oscar Peterson and Nat Adderley.

ctx.x: Yeah we got to go on one of those things. I thought I was in heaven. I didn’t know such a thing existed. You know here’s Joe Williams and Oscar Peterson and Nat Adderley.

Yeah. And it’s great for the musicians too, because it’s rare that we have more than just time to say hello, how’s it going, what’s been going on. Actually when I’m on the ship, you know, you can have long, you know, fairly meaningful conversations with these guys that you haven’t really had a chance to say much other than how’s the weather.
